blocks.zh: 導論與方法
blocks.en: Introduction and Methods

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈788〉 的法定地位：強制性章節（編號 <1000），是所有注射劑次可見微粒（subvisible particulate matter）的放行試驗
blocks.en: Understand the legal status of USP <788>: a mandatory chapter (numbered <1000) and the release test for subvisible particulate matter in all injections

blocks.zh: 掌握「微粒物質」的定義：外來的、不溶解的、非氣泡的異物顆粒
blocks.en: Master the definition of "particulate matter": extraneous, mobile, undissolved substances that are not gas bubbles

blocks.zh: 了解兩種測試方法的原理：Method 1 光阻法（Light Obscuration）和 Method 2 顯微法（Microscopic）的互補關係
blocks.en: Understand the principles of the two test methods: Method 1 Light Obscuration and Method 2 Microscopic, and how they complement each other

blocks.zh: 認識 USP 〈788〉 與 EP 2.9.19、JP 的國際調和背景
blocks.en: Recognize the international harmonization of USP <788> with EP 2.9.19 and JP

blocks.zh: 掌握系統適用性和環境適用性測試的基本要求
blocks.en: Master the basic requirements for system suitability and environment suitability testing

blocks.zh: 0.1 Introduction & Scope — 導論與適用範圍
blocks.en: 0.1 Introduction & Scope

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP 〈788〉 的法定地位：這是一個強制性章節（General Chapter 編號 <1000）。當注射劑專論引用此章節時，必須嚴格遵守其測試方法和限值。這不是「建議性指引」，而是有法律約束力的放行測試（release test）。
blocks.en: Legal status of USP <788>: This is a mandatory chapter (General Chapter number <1000). When an injection monograph references this chapter, its test methods and limits must be followed strictly. It is not a "recommended guideline" but a legally binding release test.

blocks.zh: Particulate Matter（微粒物質）定義的四個要素：
blocks.en: The four elements of the particulate matter definition:

blocks.zh: Extraneous（外來的） — 不是產品本身的組成部分
blocks.en: Extraneous — not a component of the product itself

blocks.zh: Mobile（可移動的） — 不是黏附在容器壁上的固定物
blocks.en: Mobile — not fixed matter adhering to the container wall

blocks.zh: Undissolved（不溶解的） — 是固態顆粒，不是溶液中的溶質
blocks.en: Undissolved — solid particles, not solutes in solution

blocks.zh: Unintentionally present（非刻意存在的） — 排除了懸浮製劑中的活性成分微粒
blocks.en: Unintentionally present — excludes the active ingredient particles in suspension formulations

blocks.zh: 國際調和（Harmonization）：USP 〈788〉 與 EP 2.9.19 和 JP 已完成國際調和，三大藥典不會單方面修改此章節。這意味著全球製藥公司只需建立一套微粒測試方法，即可滿足美國、歐洲和日本市場的要求。
blocks.en: Harmonization: USP <788> has been harmonized with EP 2.9.19 and JP, and the three pharmacopoeias will not revise this chapter unilaterally. This means a global pharmaceutical company needs to establish only one particle test method to meet the requirements of the US, European and Japanese markets.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 飲用水中的雜質檢測：
blocks.en: Testing for impurities in drinking water:

blocks.zh: 想像你要確保瓶裝水的品質。USP 〈788〉 就像是「自來水中懸浮固體物（TSS）」的檢測標準 — 但更嚴格千萬倍，因為這些液體是要直接注射進人體血管或組織的。
blocks.en: Imagine you need to ensure the quality of bottled water. USP <788> is like the test standard for "total suspended solids (TSS)" in tap water, but ten million times stricter, because these liquids are injected directly into blood vessels or tissue.

blocks.zh: 定義中排除「氣泡」很重要 — 就像你不會把水中的小氣泡算作「雜質」一樣。但固態異物顆粒（玻璃碎片、橡膠屑、纖維）就完全不同了，它們可能堵塞微血管或引發免疫反應。
blocks.en: Excluding "gas bubbles" from the definition is important, just as you would not count tiny air bubbles in water as "impurities". Solid foreign particles (glass fragments, rubber shavings, fibers) are a completely different matter: they can block capillaries or trigger immune reactions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 豁免產品：三類產品獲得豁免：(1) 沖洗液（irrigating solutions）、(2) 放射性藥物（radiopharmaceuticals）、(3) 標示使用前需加終端過濾器的產品（但需有科學數據支持）。在 CDMO 場景中，這意味著你需要清楚辨別客戶產品是否適用 〈788〉。大多數注射劑（IV、IM、SC）都必須符合。
blocks.en: Exempt products: Three categories of products are exempt: (1) irrigating solutions, (2) radiopharmaceuticals, (3) products labeled for use with a terminal filter (supported by scientific data). In a CDMO setting, this means you need to clearly determine whether a client's product is subject to <788>. Most injections (IV, IM, SC) must comply.

blocks.zh: IM 和 SC 也納入：不只是靜脈注射（IV），肌肉注射（IM）和皮下注射（SC）產品也必須符合 〈788〉。這擴大了適用範圍，涵蓋了幾乎所有注射劑型。
blocks.en: IM and SC are also included: Not only intravenous (IV) products but also intramuscular (IM) and subcutaneous (SC) products must comply with <788>. This broadens the scope to cover almost all injectable dosage forms.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Industry Application
blocks.en: CDMO Industry Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：作為無菌充填代工廠，USP 〈788〉 是你最常執行的 QC 放行測試之一。每一批注射劑產品出貨前都必須通過微粒測試。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: As a sterile fill-finish contract manufacturer, USP <788> is one of the QC release tests you perform most often. Every batch of injectable product must pass the particle test before shipment.

blocks.zh: 客戶產品登記 — 註冊文件（CTD Module 3）中必須包含 〈788〉 測試方法和接受標準
blocks.en: Client product registration — the <788> test method and acceptance criteria must be included in the registration dossier (CTD Module 3)

blocks.zh: 批次放行 — 每批產品的 Certificate of Analysis (CoA) 都必須列出微粒計數結果
blocks.en: Batch release — the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) for each batch must report the particle count results

blocks.zh: 製程驗證 — PPQ 批次必須證明微粒計數穩定且符合限值
blocks.en: Process validation — PPQ batches must demonstrate that particle counts are stable and within the limits

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 〈788〉 需要國際調和？如果三大藥典各有不同的微粒限值，對全球 CDMO 會造成什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does USP <788> need international harmonization? If the three pharmacopoeias had different particle limits, what problems would that cause for a global CDMO?

blocks.zh: 一個標示「使用前需加 0.22 µm 終端過濾器」的產品可以豁免 〈788〉。但作為 CDMO，你會建議客戶依賴這個豁免嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A product labeled "use with a 0.22 µm terminal filter" can be exempt from <788>. As a CDMO, would you advise a client to rely on this exemption? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 0.2 Method Selection — 方法選擇
blocks.en: 0.2 Method Selection

blocks.zh: 兩種驗鈔方式：
blocks.en: Two ways of checking banknotes:

blocks.zh: Method 1（光阻法）就像驗鈔機 — 把鈔票塞進去，機器自動快速判別真偽和數量。但如果鈔票是濕的、皺的、或黏在一起的，機器可能無法正確讀取。
blocks.en: Method 1 (light obscuration) is like a banknote counting machine: you feed the notes in and the machine quickly and automatically verifies authenticity and count. But if the notes are wet, crumpled or stuck together, the machine may not read them correctly.

blocks.zh: Method 2（顯微法）就像銀行行員用放大鏡手動檢查每張鈔票 — 速度慢但什麼情況都能處理，是最終的「仲裁方法」。
blocks.en: Method 2 (microscopic) is like a bank teller manually examining each note with a magnifying glass: slow, but it can handle any situation, and it is the final "referee method".

blocks.zh: 大部分情況用驗鈔機就夠了（快速、準確），只有特殊情況才需要人工檢查。
blocks.en: In most cases the counting machine is enough (fast and accurate); manual inspection is needed only in special cases.

blocks.zh: 不能外推（Cannot Extrapolate）：USP 特別強調，檢測幾個單位的結果不能代表整批產品。這是因為微粒污染的分佈是隨機的 — 一個小瓶可能完全乾淨，旁邊的小瓶可能有玻璃碎片。因此必須制定統計學上合理的抽樣計畫。
blocks.en: Cannot extrapolate: USP specifically emphasizes that results from testing a few units cannot represent the whole batch. This is because particulate contamination is randomly distributed: one vial may be completely clean while the vial next to it contains glass fragments. A statistically sound sampling plan is therefore required.

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見挑戰：在無菌充填代工中，常見的導致 Method 1 不適用的產品類型包括：
blocks.en: Common CDMO challenges: In sterile fill-finish contract manufacturing, product types that commonly make Method 1 unsuitable include:

blocks.zh: 脂質體製劑（liposomal） — 脂質體本身會被光阻法偵測為「粒子」
blocks.en: Liposomal formulations — the liposomes themselves are detected as "particles" by light obscuration

blocks.zh: 蛋白質製劑 — 某些高濃度蛋白質溶液呈乳光
blocks.en: Protein formulations — some high-concentration protein solutions are opalescent

blocks.zh: 懸浮製劑 — API 本身是不溶解的微粒
blocks.en: Suspension formulations — the API itself is undissolved particulate

blocks.zh: 含界面活性劑產品 — 搖晃後產生大量氣泡，干擾光阻法
blocks.en: Products containing surfactants — shaking generates large numbers of bubbles that interfere with light obscuration

blocks.zh: 一個 mRNA-LNP 疫苗（脂質奈米粒子載體）需要做 〈788〉 微粒測試。你會選擇哪種方法？為什麼？
blocks.en: An mRNA-LNP vaccine (lipid nanoparticle carrier) requires <788> particle testing. Which method would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 要求「statistically sound sampling plans」而不是簡單規定「每批測試 N 個單位」？這與微粒污染的本質有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does USP require "statistically sound sampling plans" rather than simply specifying "test N units per batch"? How does this relate to the nature of particulate contamination?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 方法選擇決策樹
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Method Selection Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 兩種方法的互補關係：
blocks.en: How the two methods complement each other:

blocks.zh: 決策邏輯：先用 Method 1 測試 → 如果通過，則合格；如果超標，再用 Method 2 複測。如果 Method 1 不適用（渾濁、高黏度、乳劑），直接用 Method 2。
blocks.en: Decision logic: Test with Method 1 first. If it passes, the product complies; if it exceeds the limits, retest with Method 2. If Method 1 is not applicable (turbid, highly viscous, emulsions), go directly to Method 2.

blocks.zh: 0.3 Method 1: Light Obscuration Particle Count Test — 光阻微粒計數法
blocks.en: 0.3 Method 1: Light Obscuration Particle Count Test

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 光阻法原理與操作
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Principle and Operation of Light Obscuration

blocks.zh: 光阻法（Light Obscuration）原理：液體通過一個光束感測器（sensor），當粒子經過光束時，會產生一個「陰影」，遮擋部分光線。感測器偵測到光強度的降低，根據陰影的大小推算粒子的等效球形直徑，同時計算粒子數量。
blocks.en: Principle of light obscuration: The liquid passes through a light-beam sensor. When a particle crosses the beam it casts a "shadow" that blocks part of the light. The sensor detects the drop in light intensity, calculates the equivalent spherical diameter of the particle from the size of the shadow, and counts the particles at the same time.

blocks.zh: 校正標準品：使用已知尺寸的球形標準粒子（通常是聚苯乙烯乳膠微球，polystyrene latex beads）來校正儀器。校正範圍覆蓋 10 µm 和 25 µm 兩個關鍵閾值。
blocks.en: Calibration standards: The instrument is calibrated with spherical standard particles of known size (usually polystyrene latex beads). The calibration range covers the two key thresholds of 10 µm and 25 µm.

blocks.zh: USP Particle Count RS：USP 參考標準品，用於驗證系統適用性（system suitability），確認儀器在測試當天能正確計數和分級粒子。
blocks.en: USP Particle Count RS: A USP Reference Standard used to verify system suitability, confirming that the instrument counts and sizes particles correctly on the day of testing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 環境適用性測試
blocks.en: Key Notes: Environment Suitability Test

blocks.zh: 環境空白測試限值：5 × 5 mL = 25 mL 的無粒子水中，≥10 µm 的粒子不得超過 25 個（即平均每 mL 不超過 1 個）。這是確保你的測試環境、玻璃器皿和水質不會對結果造成干擾的基本門檻。
blocks.en: Environment blank limit: In 5 × 5 mL = 25 mL of particle-free water, there must be no more than 25 particles of ≥10 µm (an average of no more than 1 per mL). This is the basic threshold to ensure that your test environment, glassware and water quality do not interfere with the results.

blocks.zh: 丟棄第一份樣品：從容器中取出的前 5 mL（第一份）必須丟棄不計。這是因為第一份液體會沖洗管路和感測器，攜帶系統中殘留的粒子。只有後三份的平均值才代表真實的樣品微粒水平。
blocks.en: Discard the first portion: The first 5 mL (first portion) withdrawn from the container must be discarded and not counted. The first portion flushes the tubing and sensor and carries residual particles from the system. Only the average of the remaining three portions represents the true particle level of the sample.

blocks.zh: 公式計算 Sample Preparation Logic
blocks.en: Calculation: Sample Preparation Logic

blocks.zh: SVP（小量注射劑）樣品準備：
blocks.en: SVP (small-volume parenteral) sample preparation:

blocks.zh:
如果單瓶容量 < 25 mL：
  合併 ≥10 瓶 → 總體積 ≥ 25 mL
  或合併數瓶 + 無粒子水稀釋至 25 mL

如果單瓶容量 ≥ 25 mL：
  可以單瓶測試

測試流程：
  取 4 × (≥5 mL) = ≥20 mL
  丟棄第 1 份結果
  取第 2、3、4 份的平均值
blocks.en:
If the volume per container is < 25 mL:
  Combine ≥10 containers → total volume ≥ 25 mL
  Or combine several containers + dilute to 25 mL with particle-free water

If the volume per container is ≥ 25 mL:
  A single container can be tested

Test procedure:
  Withdraw 4 × (≥5 mL) = ≥20 mL
  Discard the result of portion 1
  Take the average of portions 2, 3 and 4

blocks.zh: LVP（大量注射劑）：直接單瓶測試，無需合併。
blocks.en: LVP (large-volume parenteral): Test single containers directly; no pooling is needed.

blocks.zh: 水龍頭第一杯水的道理：
blocks.en: The logic of the first cup from the tap:

blocks.zh: 為什麼要丟棄第一份樣品？這就像早上打開水龍頭，第一杯水通常帶有管道中隔夜積存的雜質和鏽斑，你不會用這杯水來判斷自來水的品質。先讓水流幾秒「沖洗」管路，之後流出的水才代表真正的水質。
blocks.en: Why discard the first portion? It is like turning on the tap in the morning: the first cup usually carries impurities and rust that sat overnight in the pipes, and you would not use that cup to judge the quality of the tap water. Let the water run for a few seconds to "flush" the pipes, and only the water that comes afterward represents the true water quality.

blocks.zh: 同理，光阻法儀器的感測器和管路在第一次吸取樣品時，會把之前殘留的粒子帶出來，所以第一份數據不可靠。
blocks.en: Likewise, when the first sample is drawn, the sensor and tubing of a light obscuration instrument carry out particles left from earlier, so the first portion of data is unreliable.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Particle Contamination Sources
blocks.en: CDMO Industry Application: Particle Contamination Sources

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見微粒污染來源：
blocks.en: Common sources of particulate contamination in a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 玻璃（Glass） — 西林瓶脫片（delamination）、瓶口破損產生的玻璃碎屑
blocks.en: Glass — vial delamination, and glass fragments from damaged vial necks

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞（Stopper） — 膠塞被穿刺針頭切割產生的橡膠微粒（coring）
blocks.en: Stopper — rubber particles cut from the stopper by a piercing needle (coring)

blocks.zh: 不銹鋼（Stainless Steel） — 配液設備磨損、焊縫缺陷脫落的金屬微粒
blocks.en: Stainless steel — metal particles from wear of compounding equipment or shedding from weld defects

blocks.zh: 纖維（Fiber） — 人員操作時衣物、手套釋放的纖維
blocks.en: Fiber — fibers released from garments and gloves during personnel operations

blocks.zh: 濾膜碎片 — 除菌過濾時濾膜完整性受損脫落的碎片
blocks.en: Filter membrane fragments — fragments shed when membrane integrity is compromised during sterilizing filtration

blocks.zh: 結晶/沉澱 — 產品配方不穩定導致的 API 或賦形劑結晶
blocks.en: Crystals/precipitates — crystallization of API or excipients caused by an unstable formulation

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 剛完成一批 2 mL 小瓶充填（共 10,000 瓶）。準備做 〈788〉 Method 1 測試時，你需要合併多少瓶來製備一份測試溶液？如果要測試 3 份獨立的測試溶液，總共需要多少瓶？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has just completed filling a batch of 2 mL vials (10,000 vials in total). To perform <788> Method 1, how many vials do you need to pool to prepare one test solution? If you need to test 3 independent test solutions, how many vials are needed in total?

blocks.zh: 環境適用性測試失敗（25 mL 無粒子水中 ≥10 µm 粒子 = 35 個，超過 25 個限值）。你會從哪些方面排查原因？
blocks.en: The environment suitability test fails (in 25 mL of particle-free water, ≥10 µm particles = 35, exceeding the limit of 25). Which areas would you investigate to find the cause?

blocks.zh: 0.4 Method 2: Microscopic Particle Count Test — 顯微微粒計數法
blocks.en: 0.4 Method 2: Microscopic Particle Count Test

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 顯微法關鍵要素
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Key Elements of the Microscopic Method

blocks.zh: 顯微法的獨特價值：光阻法告訴你「有多少個粒子」和「多大」，但顯微法還能告訴你「粒子長什麼樣」— 是玻璃碎片？橡膠屑？纖維？金屬微粒？這對根因分析（Root Cause Analysis）極為重要。
blocks.en: The unique value of the microscopic method: Light obscuration tells you "how many particles" there are and "how large" they are, but microscopy also tells you "what the particles look like": glass fragments? Rubber shavings? Fibers? Metal particles? This is extremely important for root cause analysis.

blocks.zh: 雙重照明系統：
blocks.en: Dual illumination system:

blocks.zh: Episcopic illumination（表面照明） — 從上方照射，讓不透明粒子（金屬、橡膠）在暗色濾膜上清晰可見
blocks.en: Episcopic illumination — light from above, so that opaque particles (metal, rubber) are clearly visible on the dark filter membrane

blocks.zh: Oblique illumination（斜射照明，10°–20°） — 從側面斜射，讓透明粒子（玻璃、結晶）產生邊緣反光而被偵測到
blocks.en: Oblique illumination (10°–20°) — light at a low angle from the side, so that transparent particles (glass, crystals) produce edge reflections and are detected

blocks.zh: 黑色濾膜的用途：使用黑色或深灰色濾膜（不是常見的白色濾膜），目的是讓淺色和透明的粒子在深色背景上更容易被觀察到。
blocks.en: Purpose of the black filter membrane: A black or dark gray membrane (not the common white membrane) is used so that light-colored and transparent particles are easier to see against the dark background.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 粒子分級規則
blocks.en: Key Notes: Particle Sizing Rules

blocks.zh: 透明 vs 不透明粒子的測量差異：
blocks.en: Different measurement for transparent vs. opaque particles:

blocks.zh: 白色/透明粒子 → 使用透明參考圓的內徑進行比較
blocks.en: White/transparent particles → compare using the inner diameter of the transparent reference circle

blocks.zh: 深色/不透明粒子 → 使用黑色參考圓的外徑進行比較
blocks.en: Dark/opaque particles → compare using the outer diameter of the black reference circle

blocks.zh: 這個規則確保了不同顏色/透明度的粒子都能被一致地分級。不遵守此規則會導致系統性的測量偏差。
blocks.en: This rule ensures that particles of different color and transparency are sized consistently. Not following it leads to systematic measurement bias.

blocks.zh: 不計入的物質：在濾膜上呈現染色或薄膜狀的非晶形（amorphous）、半液體（semiliquid）物質不應被計為微粒。這些可能是蛋白質聚集體或製劑成分沉積，需要另外用光阻法來確認。
blocks.en: Material not counted: Amorphous, semiliquid material that appears as a stain or film on the membrane should not be counted as particles. It may be protein aggregates or deposits of formulation components and needs to be confirmed separately by light obscuration.

blocks.zh: CSI 犯罪現場鑑識：
blocks.en: CSI crime scene forensics:

blocks.zh: 如果光阻法（Method 1）是一台「自動指紋掃描儀」— 快速告訴你現場有多少枚指紋，那顯微法（Method 2）就是鑑識專家趴在地上用放大鏡一個一個看 — 不僅數數量，還能判斷「這是腳印還是手印？是皮鞋還是運動鞋？」
blocks.en: If light obscuration (Method 1) is an "automatic fingerprint scanner" that quickly tells you how many fingerprints are at the scene, then microscopy (Method 2) is the forensic expert on the floor with a magnifying glass examining them one by one: not just counting, but judging "Is this a footprint or a handprint? A leather shoe or a sneaker?"

blocks.zh: 在微粒分析中，顯微法能區分玻璃（透明、不規則碎片狀）、橡膠（不透明、圓形或不規則）、纖維（細長形）、金屬（不透明、有光澤），這對找出污染來源至關重要。
blocks.en: In particle analysis, microscopy can distinguish glass (transparent, irregular fragments), rubber (opaque, round or irregular), fibers (elongated) and metal (opaque, shiny), which is essential for finding the source of contamination.

blocks.zh: 你的 QC 實驗室在做 Method 2 時，在濾膜上觀察到大量透明、不規則的碎片狀粒子。這最可能是什麼來源？你會建議生產部門檢查哪些環節？
blocks.en: While performing Method 2, your QC laboratory observes a large number of transparent, irregular, fragment-like particles on the membrane. What is the most likely source? Which steps would you ask the production department to check?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 規定在顯微法中不要對「染色狀或薄膜狀」物質進行計數？如果這些物質確實存在，應該怎麼處理？
blocks.en: Why does USP specify that "stain-like or film-like" material is not counted in the microscopic method? If such material is actually present, how should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 顯微法環境適用性標準
blocks.en: Key Notes: Environment Suitability Criteria for the Microscopic Method

blocks.zh: 注意顯微法的環境空白測試比光阻法更嚴格 — 不僅測 ≥10 µm，還同時測 ≥25 µm。這是因為顯微法是仲裁方法，需要更高的環境清潔度保證。
blocks.en: Note that the environment blank test for the microscopic method is stricter than for light obscuration: it tests not only ≥10 µm but also ≥25 µm. This is because the microscopic method is the referee method and requires a higher assurance of environmental cleanliness.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP 〈788〉 是強制性放行試驗，適用於幾乎所有注射劑（IV、IM、SC），與 EP 和 JP 國際調和
blocks.en: USP <788> is a mandatory release test that applies to almost all injections (IV, IM, SC) and is harmonized with EP and JP

blocks.zh: 微粒定義的四要素：外來的（extraneous）、可移動的（mobile）、不溶解的（undissolved）、非刻意存在的（unintentional）
blocks.en: The four elements of the particle definition: extraneous, mobile, undissolved, unintentionally present

blocks.zh: Method 1 光阻法為首選方法（自動化、快速），Method 2 顯微法為仲裁/補充方法（可鑑別粒子形態）
blocks.en: Method 1 light obscuration is the preferred method (automated, fast); Method 2 microscopic is the referee/supplementary method (can identify particle morphology)

blocks.zh: 環境適用性測試是前提條件 — Method 1: ≤25 粒子/25 mL 水; Method 2: ≤20 粒子(≥10 µm)/50 mL 且 ≤5 粒子(≥25 µm)/50 mL
blocks.en: Environment suitability testing is a prerequisite: Method 1: ≤25 particles/25 mL of water; Method 2: ≤20 particles (≥10 µm)/50 mL and ≤5 particles (≥25 µm)/50 mL

blocks.zh: SVP 樣品合併規則：<25 mL 的瓶裝合併 ≥10 瓶至 ≥25 mL；LVP 單瓶測試
blocks.en: SVP sample pooling rule: pool ≥10 containers of <25 mL to ≥25 mL; test LVP as single containers

blocks.zh: 光阻法丟棄第一份數據（flush effect），取後三份平均值
blocks.en: Light obscuration discards the first portion of data (flush effect) and uses the average of the remaining three portions

blocks.zh: CDMO 微粒來源：玻璃、橡膠塞、不銹鋼、纖維、濾膜碎片、結晶/沉澱
blocks.en: CDMO particle sources: glass, stoppers, stainless steel, fibers, filter membrane fragments, crystals/precipitates
